answer_1.quote: DIALOGSUM for dialogue summarization. [...] This dataset is designed to be highly abstractive, which means a generative model should be adopted to generate the summaries.

answer_2.quote: We follow to adopt Rouge (pyrouge) as our evaluation metric [...] Rouge-n computes the overlapping ratio of n-grams between the prediction and reference summaries. ROUGE-L computes the longest common subsequence (LCS) between the candidates and references.
